approach: PowerPC Mac PEF statically recompiled through Ghidra to native ARM64, with AppKit integration and incremental C++23 routine reconstruction.
notes: Apple Silicon / macOS 13+. Verified local gameplay: career creation/loading, club and player screens, date advancement, full matches, return to management, saving and reloading. Native interface scaling, keyboard commands and audio. Separate Match Debugger offers seeded simulations, substitutions, events and rewind/redo. 678 reconstructed C++23 entry points; remaining routines use generated code. Incomplete: multiplayer and some services are unsupported. Requires the original Mac 3.9.62 release and a local build; no public binary release yet.
